name: 26 Furnival Street
site_text:
Chancery Lane
PUB & RESTAURANT
Welcome
A neighbourhood pub and restaurant nestled in between Holborn and Chancery Lane.
Our menu brings together seasonal British produce and vibrant Mediterranean flavours, all cooked simply and with care. We work closely with independent London suppliers and producers - people who share our love of good ingredients, good craft and proper hospitality.
Join us for lunch, dinner or drinks, whether it’s a quick bite, a relaxed meal, after-work pints or something to celebrate.
Eat, drink, enjoy — then do it again tomorrow.
Love, 26 Furnival Street.
EAT
British & Mediterranean pub favourites cooked with care
DRINK
Craft beers & delicious global wines for every occasion

name: Karma Lounge
site_text:
Fresh Products
Fresh products are healthier, taste better, and are visually more alluring on the plate.
Skilled Chefs
A passionate team having mastered a range of cuisine styles and cooking techniques.
Best Bar
Bespoke range of cocktails, a fantastic list of wine & draught beers, there is something for everyone.
Vegan Cuisine
All dishes are prepared using fresh natural ingredients which preserve taste and nutritional value.
About Us
Between Heaven & Earth
							The character and philosophy of our variety of cuisine follow the ancestral technique of using different types of charcoal, fire and firewood. The scented trace of the smoke topped with a class that only a few adore, inherently allows us to have a select base of diners that we can accommodate without sacrificing and compromising our essence.						
				
							Your wish is our command. Whisper to us about your feelings and taste, and we will prepare for you the most delicious meals ever.

name: Jin Li
site_text:
Jinli Chinese
Restaurant
	Jinli Restaurant started it’s business in 2015. The name of "Jinli" originally come after the famous gastronomy street in Chengdu, Sichuan. The idea of "Jinli" is to bring authentic Chinese Sichuan food to London, to carry forward the traditional culture, and to have more people savor and experience the essence of Sichuan food.
Jinli restaurant has revolutionized Sichuan food in London and has been appreciated by its customers since opening. We have also been recognized by a number of media outlets and have won various awards:
Jinli restaurant has revolutionized Sichuan food in London and has been appreciated by its customers since opening. We have also been recognized by a number of media outlets and have won various awards:
- The most popular restaurant among Chinese students in London in Year 2016, Year 2017 and Year 2018
- Top 50 most voted restaurant in the UK 2017 by RedScarf
- "Golden chopsticks Award 2018" for best restaurant in England
- "Asian & Curry Award 2018" The best Chinese restaurant in the UK
- "CRTA Award 2018 Jin Li Best of Chinatown
- "Jinli Grilled fish" has been awarded the most popular Chinese dish by CCTV 2
- "Jinli Ma La Pot" has been awarded the best Chinese dish by CCTV 4
- Jinli Restaurant was interviewed and videoed by Mary Berry on BBC 1
